text_block_list.text:
With the Centaur Stakes and Sprinters Stakes approaching...
the third-year summer training camp arrived.
The set of dishes assembled and handed over for now was the exact menu that had originally been planned.

"...It's to evaluate her nearly perfected form,
make it rock-solid, and further fine-tune
her condition for the actual race."

text_block_list.name: Believe
text_block_list.text:
............
...I'll stick with this for a little while.

text_block_list.name: Believe
text_block_list.text:
As for what happens after that, though...
please let me discuss it with you again.

I nodded deeply. ...I felt the same way.
Because the situation had already gone far beyond what was expected.

What crosses my mind is that utterly staggering run
Durandal showed us at the Fan Thanksgiving Festival.

Whenever I recall that sharpness, that sheer edge,
a chill runs down my spine,
as if a blade were being pressed right against my throat...

Upon checking, Durandal has had the fastest final spurt
in 7 out of the 9 races he's run so far—
in other words, almost every single race.
Over the final 600 meters, her late-kick finishing power is second to none. So formidable that she can pull off a chasing victory in sprints, where it's usually impossible.
"So much so... that she wouldn't even allow Believe to run away with the lead from a high pace."

"Believe's strategy of 'wearing down the field'
will likely only work in favor of Durandal
as he comes flying in at the end."

Walking aimlessly along the beach alone.
The sand catches at the feet, making each step slower and slower.
choice_data_list: (Still, what should I do from here?)

text_block_list.text:
Looking up as if clinging to hope, there isn't even a moon in the night sky.
The outlook is bleak.
And at last, the footsteps came to a halt.

Along with the ruthlessly indifferent ebb and flow
of the tide, memories of the days gone by came rushing back.
In the Junior Class... Believe put in the work.

To build a body suited to the defined "form"
of sustaining speed and persevering to the very end.
While her peers were showered with glorious praise, even as her own plain, grueling days dragged on, she toiled in silence without growing weary or slacking off.

The Classic Year.
—Believe worked hard.

Calmly reassessing her own skills and current standing.
No matter what harsh measures she might have to take, she kept her eyes fixed solely on the task she must achieve.

Having powered through an intense race rotation,
she delivered the finest performance on the grandest stage.

And even after reaching the Senior year.
—Believe continued to work hard.

So that I can become the fastest.
So that I can do good work—the absolute best work.

Day in, day out, thinking only of that,
aiming only for that,
never looking aside, every single, solitary day—
choice_data_list: (Believe did her best! She really did!)

text_block_list.text:
And so, finally. At long last.
In the Takamatsunomiya Kinen—

Even though a masterpiece has been achieved,
a work worthy of being called the absolute peak, the ideal.

We know. We have always known.
Precisely because the two of us have continued to look earnestly at our own duties.

"I can also tell just how far the realm I can reach extends.
—Right now, from where I stand today."

"Even so, how are we supposed to do that?"
Thoughts kept going around in circles.

An exceptionally strong wave crashes in, sending a chill through her toes.
...Deep, deep inside her mind, a quiet cold settles in.
At that moment, all of a sudden—
One corner of her mouth lifts unnaturally.
Upon the water's surface, rippling with the noise-like sound of waves—a gruesome expression was reflected.

"Going in circles"?
"Don't know what to do"?
...Are you sure?
choice_data_list: (You just don't want to move forward... isn't that the truth?)
(You just don't want to move forward... isn't that the truth?)

text_block_list.text:
"The outlook is bleak"?
—No, that's not it.

"You're just looking away, aren't you?
...From what lies ahead."

text_block_list.name: Both
text_block_list.text: Haaaaaah!!

text_block_list.name: Believe
text_block_list.text:
(They're running... I knew it.
It's Light O-san and Durandal-san.)

text_block_list.name: Believe
text_block_list.text: (Right O-san... is so fast after all. Just how many kilometers per hour is his top speed...?)

text_block_list.name: Believe
text_block_list.text: (...And then—)

text_block_list.name: Durandal
text_block_list.text: —The Heavenly Blade.

text_block_list.name: Durandal
text_block_list.text: "Holy Light of Molière Ange"!!

text_block_list.name: Calstone Light O
text_block_list.text:
—*Gasp*...!!
*Pant, pant, pant*... Dammit!!

text_block_list.name: Calstone Light O
text_block_list.text: Ah, it's so frustrating! Infuriating! To lose to someone shouting weird move names...

text_block_list.name: Durandal
text_block_list.text:
Wait, what?! What's so weird about that move's name?!
It's cool, dammit!!

text_block_list.name: Durandal
text_block_list.text: ...Isn't she so cool, though?!

text_block_list.name: Calstone Light O
text_block_list.text:
No, move names are weird. Shouting them during a race is weird too.
—Though your late kick really is amazing.

text_block_list.name: Calstone Light O
text_block_list.text:
Durandal, I'm heading out now.
Thanks for running with me. See ya.

text_block_list.name: Durandal
text_block_list.text:
Ah, hey?! Honestly...
*I'm* the one who should be thanking you for running with me—!!

text_block_list.name: Durandal
text_block_list.text: And... oh?

text_block_list.name: Believe
text_block_list.text: ...Good evening, Durandal-san.

text_block_list.name: Durandal
text_block_list.text: Yes, it is a lovely evening, Believe-san.

text_block_list.name: Durandal
text_block_list.text:
...I wonder if you were watching?
Watching how I ran.

text_block_list.name: Believe
text_block_list.text:
...Yes.
Her sharp turn of foot at the Fan Appreciation Festival was brilliant as well.
However—

text_block_list.name: Believe
text_block_list.text:
Furthermore, her edge has sharpened even more.
...That's what her recent run told me.

text_block_list.name: Durandal
text_block_list.text: —I'm honored.

text_block_list.name: Durandal
text_block_list.text:
"Believe-san. ...After all, this is a blade I polished
for no other reason than to reach you."

text_block_list.name: Durandal
text_block_list.text:
On the blitzkrieg stage where I have chosen to wield my blade.
Solely to thrust it at the throat of you,
who reigns supreme as the Queen—

text_block_list.name: Durandal
text_block_list.text: After all, it's a blade that has been endlessly polished to reach this point.

text_block_list.name: Durandal
text_block_list.text:
"At the Centaur Stakes.
And then, at the Sprinters Stakes—"

text_block_list.name: Durandal
text_block_list.text: Let's settle this, fair and square.

text_block_list.name: Durandal
text_block_list.text:
"—Well then, I shall take my leave for tonight.
The roads are dark tonight, so please watch your step."

text_block_list.name: Believe
text_block_list.text: (And... Durandal walked away. With an unwavering... confidence in her stride.)

text_block_list.name: Believe
text_block_list.text: (...Durandal-san and I...)

text_block_list.name: Believe
text_block_list.text: (In a way... our schools of thought are different.)

text_block_list.name: Believe
text_block_list.text:
(I'll focus on 1,200m.
Durandal-san's battleground includes the mile.)

text_block_list.name: Believe
text_block_list.text:
(I'm a front-runner who pushes through.
Durandal-san is a chaser who sweeps from behind.)

text_block_list.name: Believe
text_block_list.text: (The ultimate goal of our work is the same. To be the fastest. Faster than anyone. At the pinnacle of speed. But—)

text_block_list.name: Believe
text_block_list.text: (No. We are... decisively, fundamentally different.)

text_block_list.name: Believe
text_block_list.text: (...That's why—)

text_block_list.name: Calstone Light O
text_block_list.text: —Oooooooh...!!

text_block_list.name: Calstone Light O
text_block_list.text:
Haa...!!
Haa, wheeze, haa......

text_block_list.name: Believe
text_block_list.text: ...You're still working on that, Daitaku?

text_block_list.name: Calstone Light O
text_block_list.text:
Haa... Believe, is it?
Yeah, I was still going. I'll do a bit more.

text_block_list.name: Calstone Light O
text_block_list.text: Because earlier, I was slow.

text_block_list.name: Believe
text_block_list.text: ...During training alongside Durandal-san, was it?

text_block_list.name: Calstone Light O
text_block_list.text: It was roughly the last 200 meters. The top speed Durandal unleashed in that stretch—undeniably surpassed mine.

text_block_list.name: Calstone Light O
text_block_list.text: How could I ever forgive something like that?

text_block_list.name: Calstone Light O
text_block_list.text:
Because that is my speed.
Mine. Mine alone. The speed I must see through to the end!

text_block_list.name: Calstone Light O
text_block_list.text:
That is so, Believe.
...For us.

text_block_list.name: Believe
text_block_list.text: ...Likewise.

text_block_list.name: Believe
text_block_list.text: There is a speed that cannot be surrendered, must never be yielded.

text_block_list.name: Calstone Light O
text_block_list.text:
Ah, that's right.
—And that is why I'll keep going.

text_block_list.name: Calstone Light O
text_block_list.text:
Farewell, Believe.
Or perhaps—

text_block_list.name: Calstone Light O
text_block_list.text: Until the Centaur Stakes!

text_block_list.name: Believe
text_block_list.text: (...Right. Right-O-san is correct.)

text_block_list.name: Believe
text_block_list.text: (We are... I am...)

text_block_list.name: Believe
text_block_list.text: I won't give it up like this...!

"...The next morning.
Believe finally showed an unshakeable will—"
No. With a burning resolve dwelling in her eyes, she proclaimed this to me:

text_block_list.name: Believe
text_block_list.text: I'd like to restructure my training.

text_block_list.name: Believe
text_block_list.text: "I'm sure you realize it too. If we stay like this, we'll never become the fastest."

text_block_list.name: Believe
text_block_list.text:
She has polished herself to the absolute limit.
...I understand that all too well.

text_block_list.name: Believe
text_block_list.text:
However...
One look at your face tells me everything.

text_block_list.name: Believe
text_block_list.text:
Trainer.
—You've got an idea, don't you? Something.

text_block_list.name: Believe
text_block_list.text:
Something... to pull me up
to an even higher realm.

text_block_list.name: Believe
text_block_list.text: Please. Let me hear it.

text_block_list.name: Believe
text_block_list.text: ...Trainer.

"...I look up to the heavens. As if mocking that moonless night,
a violent brilliance exposes everything to broad daylight, searing my eyes."

I somehow managed to face Believe again and nodded.
...I made a promise.

That she would without fail reveal the answer...
that she had kept hidden in her heart,
that she had finally arrived at.
choice_data_list: Let's talk after today's training is finished.

text_block_list.name: Believe
text_block_list.text:
Yes.
...I'll be in your care, Trainer.

Believe nods.
Indeed, it's hard not to agree.
That was the beginning of hell.
